domain_restrictions: n is an integer and satisfies n > 1
r is real and satisfies 0 <= r < 1
m is defined as floor of n times r, hence m is an integer
m divided by n is an input value for f_n (assumes f_n is defined on it)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every integer n with n > 1 and every real r with 0 <= r < 1, if m is defined as the floor of n times r, then f_n(r) is at most f_n(m divided by n).
quantifier_order: for all integers n with n > 1
for all real numbers r with 0 <= r < 1
let m be floor of n times r
claim: f_n(r) <= f_n(m divided by n)

variables.name: n
variables.role: fixed parameter for the function f_n; assumed to satisfy n > 1

variables.name: r
variables.role: input variable to f_n constrained by 0 <= r < 1

variables.name: m
variables.role: auxiliary integer defined by m = floor(n*r); used to form the point m/n

variables.domain: unspecified set of inputs where f_n is defined (at least includes r and m/n)
variables.name: f_n

witness_dependencies: m depends on both n and r via m = floor(n*r)

statement_nl: Let n > 1 and let f_n be defined as above. For any real r with 0 <= r < 1, if m = floor(n*r), then f_n(r) <= f_n(m/n).
